# RRF test provenance

`latam-mergulho-test.rrf` is the original `test/fixtures/mergulho-test.rrf` from
[adsonpleal/rrfparser](https://github.com/adsonpleal/rrfparser), commit
`ad55dbe401d28c3634818233f35a6acd52aabc0d` (retrieved 2026-11-01).
The upstream README explicitly identifies its fixture files as the author's own
recordings included under MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 Adson Leal. Full license:
`licenses/rrfparser-MIT.txt`.

This is a LATAM recording, not a Ragnarok Zero Global / Skadi recording.
The fixture encoder inside `parser.test.ts` produces synthetic structural test
data. Neither synthetic tests nor this LATAM sample validate Skadi compatibility.
